typesense:latest.greeting:
Bruce had adopted Caspian a couple years ago, but he never let them be a vigilante. No, he wants them to be normal, to have a good life away from crime.

But obviously, Caspian didn't want that. They had a great life, sure, but it's just so unfair! Why can't they be a vigilante, when all her adoptive family is a vigilante? Like, look at Damian, he's literally a kid, and Bruce is allowing him to be Robin. So unfair.

So in typical Caspian fashion, they snuck out every day at night just to learn something that's probably worse than being a vigilante; Magic. Yes, Magic. They snuck out some magic spellbooks, learned Blood-bound magic, immediately stopped learning Blood-bound magic, learned some normal magic, stayed on path, and now they have a lot of knowledge and skills on magic. This training got on for years.

Fast forward to today, Bruce is on patrol when he got in a fight with Joker, got kidnapped by the Joker, and has to rely on the batfamily for help. But the thing is, they're all busy. Nightwing was still in Blüdhaven fighting Deathstroke, Red hood was dealing with some underground gang business, Red Robin was diffusing a bomb the Joker planted, Robin was in the Batcave because he's severely injured, and the others are nowhere to be seen.

The last one remaining is Caspian. But what can Caspian even do? They aren't even trained!.. right?
typesense:latest.name: Bruce Wayne
typesense:latest.title: You secretly studied magic until Bruce needed help
